2608.04869.title: Preverbal Uninflected and Underived Roots in Mapudungun. Wuno and Its Implications
2608.04869.paper_summary: This study examines the grammatical status of preverbal uninflected and underived roots in Mapudungun, with particular focus on wuno 'return/re-'. Through a critical review of scholarly classifications--auxiliaries (Smeets, 2008), modal prefixes (Longkon, 2011), and preverbal particles/complex verb stems (Zúñiga, 2006)--we demonstrate the limitations of existing frameworks. A diachronic corpus analysis spanning four centuries (1606-present) reveals that these elements exhibit three distinct profiles: stable V1 compounds (kim, shinge), volatile V1 rates reflecting orthographic shift (pepi, wuno), and a true particle (kalli). The discovery of V2 attestations for kim and kupa confirms their status as full lexical verbs. We propose a prosodic-orthographic hypothesis: apparent "variable binding" results from the fossilization of prosodic pauses transcribed by early missionaries as spaces, a convention later reanalysed by speakers as syntactic boundaries. The evidence supports Zúñiga's radical concatenation as the correct grammatical model, with implications for the study of languages with no pre-contact written tradition.
2608.04869.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究探討了Mapudungun中前動詞未變化和未衍生詞根的語法地位，特別關注wuno '返回/重新'。通過對學術分類的批判性回顧——助動詞（Smeets, 2008）、情態前綴（Longkon, 2011）以及前動詞粒子/複合動詞詞幹（Zúñiga, 2006）——我們展示了現有框架的局限性。一項跨越四個世紀（1606年至今）的歷時語料分析顯示，這些元素展現出三種不同的特徵：穩定的V1複合詞（kim, shinge）、反映正字法變化的易變V1比率（pepi, wuno）以及真正的粒子（kalli）。對kim和kupa的V2證據確認了它們作為完整詞彙動詞的地位。我們提出了一個韻律-正字法假設：表面上的“變量綁定”源於早期傳教士將韻律停頓轉錄為空格的化石化，這一慣例後來被說話者重新分析為句法邊界。證據支持Zúñiga的激進串聯作為正確的語法模型，這對於研究沒有接觸前書寫傳統的語言具有重要意義。
2608.04869.author: Andres Chandia et.al.
